name: Cease fire (WIP)
summary: Apply the standard cease-fire action to the specified unit only.
requirements: Requires own-unit information and a unit accepting player orders. Does not propagate to formation members.
execution_note: Cancels current attacks and attack-at-waypoint reservations, including sonobuoy drops. The standard action also ends attack alignment, laser guidance and jamming; launched weapons may lose guidance. Movement waypoints remain. Does not disable autonomous engagement settings.
